messages:
marta: quick FYI, running into missing X-Request-ID after the SDK refreshes auth in the node quickstart. repro is a fast 401 then retry.

sam: can you paste the tiny log snippet? curious if traceparent still shows up.

marta: sure. gist of it:

```
2025-02-11T09:12:01.111Z INFO outgoing request path=/v1/chat req_id=xyz-42
2025-02-11T09:12:01.333Z WARN upstream auth status=401
2025-02-11T09:12:01.556Z INFO auth refresh ok
2025-02-11T09:12:01.557Z INFO outgoing request path=/v1/chat req_id=\"\" redact=false
```

ji: looks like the retry creates a fresh low-level request and doesn't copy over the custom header. OTEL propagator probably still has traceparent but our SDK header is separate.

sam: ok that matches a hook-ordering bug i've seen. in the sampleapp we mount instrumentation before SDK auth wrapper; on retry the instrumentation doesn't reattach the ctx headers.

marta: repro is in sample-apps/node-quickstart + our local auth mock. also saw similar behavior briefly in python sample when running the same auth mock.

telemetry-bot: flaky test added: telemetry/reqid-regen failed on main at 14:03. CI: https://ci.internal/runs/9134

ji: mitigation: default to redact=true if req_id missing so we don't accidentally print sensitive payloads. also add a guard in the OTEL hook to treat empty req_id as missing.

sam: agree. short-term: set default redact=true in telemetry middleware. medium-term: SDK should preserve outgoing custom headers when doing auth refresh + retry.

infra-oncall: if redact flips off in any prod path please escalate, we could leak tokens/PII. any sign this hit prod?

marta: i don't see prod alerts. only staging and local so far. CI fail on main is concerning because it could merge.

ji: i'll open two PRs: 1) sample-app quickfix to copy headers on retry, 2) sdk change to preserve custom headers across auth refresh. will add unit + integration tests. ETA tomorrow morning.

sam: i'll add a CI integration that injects a 401 and asserts X-Request-ID present after retry and redact still true.

marta: thanks. i'll also run a staging smoke that mirrors ingress header passthrough (nginx can strip custom headers on auth redirects). will update here with the gist and PR links. :thumbsup:
